flag.note: Source key was D; this site scores B by review decision. Every symbol moves one side anticlockwise each step, and the black dot goes out, out, in, out, out, so next it is inside on the lower left: B. D puts the black dot at the upper right and the white circle outside on the lower left, which breaks the anticlockwise movement.
